title: Traefik Metrics (Placeholder - Import from Grafana.com or create custom)
description:
This is a placeholder dashboard. To enable:
1. Import dashboard from Grafana.com (search for Traefik dashboards)
2. Or create custom dashboard using Traefik v3.6.2 metrics
3. Recommended metrics:
   - Request rates: rate(traefik_entrypoint_requests_total[5m])
   - Latencies: traefik_service_request_duration_seconds
   - Error rates: rate(traefik_entrypoint_requests_total{code=~"5.."}[5m])
   - Router/service stats: traefik_router_*, traefik_service_*
